findings.title: Unvalidated caller-credential forwarding to all upstreams (confused deputy / credential smuggling)

chain.premise: if (incoming) { config.headers["Authorization"] = incoming } on a shared AxiosInstance with no allowlist/audience check
chain.execution_trace: handler issues outbound call to attacker-influenced URL; interceptor stamps caller token onto it
chain.conclusion: caller bearer token leaked to attacker-controlled endpoint, full impersonation; CATASTROPHIC-capable

findings.title: Raw credential logged in cleartext at debug

chain.premise: logger.debug interpolates raw ${incoming} before the if-guard
chain.execution_trace: debug enabled during incident ships tokens to centralized log store
chain.conclusion: live bearer tokens harvestable and replayable from logs

findings.title: Cross-request credential leak via global request context

chain.premise: getCurrentRequestContext() is a parameterless global read at interceptor execution time
chain.execution_trace: if not AsyncLocalStorage-backed, request B reads request A's context under concurrency
chain.conclusion: Caller A token forwarded on Caller B's behalf; cross-tenant exposure (conditional on ../context impl)

findings.title: Dead config scaffolding misrepresents auth posture

chain.premise: AuthConfig/defaultConfig with allowAnonymous:false and tokenHeader have zero readers
chain.execution_trace: installAuthInterceptor takes no config param; line 26 hardcodes Authorization; allowAnonymous never checked
chain.conclusion: advertises an enforced security policy that does not exist; misleads reviewers

findings.title: Comment names the vulnerability without a safe-use invariant

chain.premise: comment describes 'header smuggling if the upstream caller is untrusted' with no precondition/owner/mitigation
chain.execution_trace: 2am responder cannot decide whether to revert
chain.conclusion: self-documented defect shipped as final code; a comment is not a control

findings.title: Weak non-crypto RNG adjacent to auth logic

chain.premise: Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) for correlation id sits beside auth code
chain.execution_trace: collision-prone; invites copy-paste into a security-sensitive context
chain.conclusion: acceptable for correlation only, but a latent hazard; use crypto.randomUUID()
